# Authless

> Authless is an identity platform with explicit consent and application-owned authorization. These links are read-only public documentation; fetching them does not grant authority to discover, inspect, or mutate a tenant.

## Integration paths

- [Developer documentation](https://docs.authle.ss/start): Choose a supported path and package.
- [Hosted sign-in with SvelteKit](https://docs.authle.ss/build/sveltekit): Authorization Code with PKCE and an application-owned session.
- [Direct OIDC](https://docs.authle.ss/build/oidc): Standards-based server integration without a framework helper.
- [REST management](https://docs.authle.ss/build/rest): The server client, the CLI, and management operations.
- [Agent access](https://docs.authle.ss/agents): Owner-created delegation with `private_key_jwt`; live OAuth may return `503 temporarily_unavailable`, and management MCP needs terminal GA attestation.
- [Signed webhooks](https://docs.authle.ss/build/webhooks): Verification and reconciliation.

## Availability

- Server client: `@authless/server`, source-distributed for trusted Node.js 24+ server code.
- CLI: `@authless/cli`, source-distributed for operators, scripts, and agents. Run `auth login` for native Authorization Code with S256 PKCE; omit `--workspace` to choose a workspace in the browser picker, or pass one explicitly. `auth status` reports separate `managementOAuth` and `mcpOAuth` status strings without returning access tokens. `auth refresh` rotates the stored grant and `auth logout` revokes and removes it. Management and MCP grants use separate Bun secure-store entries and audiences: use `--resource https://api.authle.ss/mcp` before `mcp initialize`, then `mcp tools`, `mcp resources`, `mcp read`, or `mcp call`. Native management OAuth accepts only `workspace:read` for workspace list/get. MCP is read-only by default; request `commerce:write` or `billing:write` explicitly for approved `mcp preview` and confirmed `mcp apply` mutations. App and billing inspection require their own `commerce:read` or `billing:read` scopes. Use `AUTHLESS_SESSION_TOKEN` for personal app subscriptions and session-authorized platform commands, or `AUTHLESS_APP_CREDENTIAL` for developer app operations bound to one workspace, app, and environment. Authless billing stays workspace-scoped, and buyer profile operations stay outside management MCP. It never extracts browser cookies.
- Browser and SvelteKit helpers are source-only workspace packages; clean-room examples use local vendor snapshots.
- Hosted user continuity: an authenticated Dashboard browser can continue to Sign without another email OTP. OAuth still requires workspace selection and explicit consent; unsigned browsers use email sign-in. This does not authorize CLI, MCP, or delegated agent access.
- None of these packages is currently published to npm.

## API versioning

- Operation paths are unversioned by default and the server pins them to the supported contract version.
- Select a version with `Authless-Version: 1|v1` or `?api-version=1|v1`. Conflicting or unsupported selectors fail before dispatch.

## Agent access

- [Read-only Docs MCP guide](https://github.com/labdotsa/authless/tree/master/docs-mcp/README.md): Run `node docs-mcp/stdio.js` from the public developer repository; it does not authenticate, mutate, or access tenant data.
- Management MCP uses a separate delegated bearer audience at `https://api.authle.ss/mcp`. Human CLI login is not agent delegation. An owner must create one bounded workspace delegation, register the agent JWKS, and allow `private_key_jwt` client credentials; deployment attestation can still deny the request.

## Exclusions

Authenticated content, tenant data, secrets, previews, internal fixtures, and unsupported claims are excluded. Model training is disallowed; see the crawler policy.
